Class AvroDecimal256Consumer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.arrow.adapter.avro.consumers.BaseAvroConsumer<Decimal256Vector>
org.apache.arrow.adapter.avro.consumers.logical.AvroDecimal256Consumer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Consumer<Decimal256Vector>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AvroDecimal256Consumer.BytesDecimal256Consumer, AvroDecimal256Consumer.FixedDecimal256Consumer
public abstract class AvroDecimal256Consumer extends BaseAvroConsumer<Decimal256Vector>
Consumer which consume 256-bit decimal type values from avro decoder. Write the data to Decimal256Vector.
